subject: Cohort credits: stacking with sandbox + path to Dedicated conversion
messages:

Subject: Intro: LaunchForge cohort credits + sandbox stacking question

Ben / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team loved the low-latency routing demo. We're finalizing terms for our summer Cohort 3.0 and have a couple of asks before we lock: can cohort promotional credits be stacked on top of the standard sandbox voucher that founders get? We typically offer a sandbox pool to startups and want to top that with Redwood credits for compute-heavy weeks. If stacking is possible, can those credits be converted/ported to a Dedicated reservation (with a conversion credit) if a startup scales up during the cohort?

High-level numbers from our side: cohort pool = $25k in vouchers across 18 teams; typical sandbox voucher = $2k per team. We're trying to avoid double-counting but want a clear pathway from pilot -> paid Dedicated where possible.

Also: procurement will ask for an invoice path and a short DocuSign for the credit terms — can you share a template or an example?

Appreciate fast turnaround — our kickoff is week of Aug 18.

Best,
Jordan Park
Partnerships, LaunchForge

Subject: Re: Intro: LaunchForge cohort credits + sandbox stacking question

Jordan — great to connect yesterday. Short answers: yes, we can support stacking and we offer a structured conversion path to Dedicated, but there are a few guardrails we recommend to keep unit economics sane.

Options I propose (summary):
- Option A: Stacked vouchers (cohort + sandbox) with a hard per-startup cap; cohort credits expire at cohort end and sandbox vouchers remain. No conversion credit.
- Option B: Stacked vouchers + conversion credit: cohort organizers purchase a small conversion buffer (reserved in escrow) that grants a one-time credit toward a Dedicated reservation if a startup converts within 90 days. The buffer is normally 20-40% of expected first-month Dedicated run-rate.
- Option C: Limited stacking with milestone gating: credits unlock in tranches tied to demo day attendance / usage thresholds. Conversion credit only for teams that hit milestone.

Attached is a quick spreadsheet (LF-proposed-credits-v1.xlsx) showing cost-to-Redwood and a sample conversion credit at 30% of first-month committed spend. I'm cc'ing Laura (who owns packaging ops) so she can flag compliance or billing constraints.

Docs: I can share a short credit addendum and an invoice flow. DocuSign link will be provided once terms agreed.

Would you be available for a 20 min call tomorrow to finalize which option you prefer?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0132

Subject: FW: LaunchForge cohort credits + stacking — need pricing guidance and approval

Team — forwarding LaunchForge ask. Proposal in my reply (Option B is their preferred direction). Key asks for leadership: approve a conversion credit structure and confirm acceptable maximum stacking exposure. Details below:
- Cohort: $25k pool (LaunchForge pays). Sandbox vouchers: $2k per team (LaunchForge funds). Potential stacking exposure if teams use both heavily in demo weeks.
- Proposed conversion credit: 30% of first-month Dedicated commit (applied as one-time credit against the first invoice) if startup converts within 90 days and signs a 3-month minimum Dedicated reservation. Conversion credit to be funded from a reserved escrow line paid by LaunchForge (we can invoice them upfront or hold on Redwood's side and invoice later).

Questions for pricing/finance:
1) Is 30% safe for us at scale? Priyom — any concerns on margin or precedent?
2) If we allow escrow-funded conversion credits, what should the minimum committed amount be to qualify (e.g., $5k/month)?
3) Any deal ops or tax implications if LaunchForge prepays escrow and we later credit a customer (Marissa, pls flag accounting implications).

I need to revert to Jordan with a recommended structure and sample DocuSign language by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Ben
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-06T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: LaunchForge cohort credits + stacking — need pricing guidance and approval

Ben — quick thoughts:
- 30% conversion credit is reasonable as a one-time promotional concession if the committed Dedicated spend meets a minimum. I recommend a $6k/mo minimum (so conversion credit only applies for commitments >= $6k/month). That avoids too many sub-$2k commitments where credit becomes material.
- Escrow model is preferred (LaunchForge prepays the pool). From accounting: we should recognize revenue when credits are consumed by end customers; until then it sits as deferred liability. If LaunchForge prepays and we later issue credits, the credit redemption should reduce deferred revenue — accounting can handle but we need clear paperwork.
- Milestone gating: prefer tranches tied to demo day + usage threshold (e.g., 100k tokens or X inference minutes) to prevent a spike on day 1 from burning all cohort credits.

Marissa — please confirm if ops can support a 90-day conversion window and whether we can automate escrow draws against signed DocuSign. If yes, I'll greenlight 30% at >=$6k/mo with tranches.

-Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan@launchforge.co>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: LaunchForge cohort credits + sandbox stacking question

Jordan — thanks for your patience. Ben looped me in to confirm operational and billing details. We can do the following if LaunchForge approves: 

Final proposal (recommended):
1) Stacking allowed: cohort credits stack on top of per-team sandbox vouchers, but cohort credits are assigned at cohort level and expire 60 days after cohort close. Sandbox vouchers remain available per standard terms.
2) Conversion credit: LaunchForge prepays an escrow of $7,500 (covers up to 25% conversion-credit capacity). For any startup that converts to Dedicated within 90 days and signs >= $6k/mo for at least 3 months, Redwood applies a one-time credit equal to 30% of the first month invoice (capped by the escrow).
3) Milestones/tranches: cohort credits release in two tranches — 60% at cohort start and 40% at demo day attendance. This prevents front-loading abuse.
4) Billing & paperwork: we'll send a short addendum (attached: redwood-cohort-terms-draft.pdf) plus the DocuSign link for the escrow payment. LaunchForge Finance will receive a consolidated invoice showing escrow receipt and the cohort pool allocation.

Next steps:
- Jordan: confirm you accept the $7,500 escrow and milestone gating. If yes, we'll send the DocuSign and a sample invoice.
- Once DocuSigned, Laura will provision the cohort pool and handoff to the onboarding team.

Ben — thanks for driving. Jordan — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to review the addendum.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Partnerships Operations | Redwood Inference
